description: This PHP script generates an HTML page for the SuiteCRM installation site configuration step, including form inputs for site URL, system name, admin credentials, and database collation options, with session handling and error display.

methods.name: getDbConnection
methods.description: Retrieves database connection object supporting collation list and default collation.

methods.description: Returns language header attributes for HTML tag.

methods.name: get_select_options_with_id
methods.description: Generates HTML select options with specified default selection.
